mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means to put out of possession, to deprive of, to expel from, to force overleaf or to put into the place of another."
The verb 'to oust' means to put out of possession, to deprive of, to expel from, to force overleaf or to put into the place of another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a condition precedent to the exercise of jurisdiction by a court."
A pre-action notice is a condition precedent to the exercise of jurisdiction by a court.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to binding rules of behaviour which are recognized as obligatory by those concerned in the working of the Constitution."
Conventions refer to binding rules of behaviour which are recognized as obligatory by those concerned in the working of the Constitution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a minor chieftaincy title under the prescribed authority of the 1st respondent."
The Ojumu stool is a minor chieftaincy title under the prescribed authority of the 1st respondent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a legal instrument giving rise amongst other things, to individual rights capable of enforcement in a Court of Law."
Constitution is a legal instrument giving rise amongst other things, to individual rights capable of enforcement in a Court of Law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the immunity endowed some Government officers against litigation."
Constitutional Immunity Constitutional immunity refers to the immunity endowed some Government officers against litigation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a blessing to a nation where properly followed."
The principle of Separation of Power is a blessing to a nation where properly followed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to determine the constitutionality of an action."
Judicial review is used to determine the constitutionality of an action.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the major provisions of the Constitution."
Protection of Public Officers is one of the major provisions of the Constitution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the nation as a Federal Republic."
The Nigerian Constitution refers to the nation as a Federal Republic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a citizen of the United States born in 1955 but has been resident in United Kingdom since 1972."
Franklin Agee is a citizen of the United States born in 1955 but has been resident in United Kingdom since 1972.
